title: current_state parse failure silently falls back to counter=0 in queryChanges
description: contact.rs:719-723: after correctly returning cannotCalculateChanges when sinceQueryState fails to parse, the same handler uses unwrap_or(0) for current_state parse failure. A DB returning an unexpected state token causes the comparison to be against 0, silently reporting all changes as new rather than propagating a server error. The sinceQueryState path has the right error path; current_state must match it.
